title: What you're listening to, as an image

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Imagine a GitHub profile that shows the song you're playing right now, with matching colors.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: That's novatorem, and Antoine maintains a fork of it. It builds a music status widget as an SVG image you can embed in a README.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Where does the music data come from?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Spotify or Last.fm. Each has its own module, and a small Flask app picks one and handles the rendering.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: The album artwork does double duty. It's shown in the widget, and its colors are used to style the SVG, so the card matches the cover.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: So it updates as you listen.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Yes, it's a live listening status. It's mostly Python with Jinja templates, and the upstream author is credited. The page has more.
